en.headline: Police and Shenzhen authorities bust cross-border credit card fraud syndicate
en.dek: Thirty-three people were arrested in a joint operation over at least 60 cases involving more than HK$1.8 million, targeting Hong Kong visitors in Shenzhen.
body: Hong Kong police and Shenzhen public security authorities have dismantled an organised cross-border credit card fraud syndicate, arresting 33 people in total.

Police said the operation, conducted from August to October, targeted a group that stole credit cards from Hong Kong residents visiting popular tourist spots or entertainment venues in Shenzhen. The cards were brought back to Hong Kong and used to buy high-value mobile phones for resale.

At least 60 cases were involved, with total losses exceeding HK$1.8 million. Individual victims lost more than HK$110,000. Sixteen people aged 17 to 45 were arrested in Hong Kong on suspicion of handling stolen goods, conspiracy to defraud and obtaining property by deception. Shenzhen authorities arrested 17 others, including the alleged mastermind.

Investigators described a three-tier structure: the mastermind recruited card users and coordinated with pickpockets; supervisors transported the cards across the border and monitored purchases; and local and mainland card users bought phones at designated second-hand shops before returning proceeds to Shenzhen.
Police recovered 13 phones bought with stolen cards, nine stolen credit cards and related receipts. They stressed that close intelligence sharing with Shenzhen made the arrests possible.

zh.headline: 警方聯同深圳公安搞破跨境信用卡詐騙集團 拘33人
zh.dek: 行動涉最少60宗案件，騙款逾180萬港元，專門針對赴深圳熱門地點的香港市民。
body: 香港警方與深圳市公安局合作，成功瓦解一個有組織的跨境信用卡詐騙集團，兩地共拘33人。
警方表示，今年8月至10月展開行動，集團專門在深圳熱門旅遊地點或娛樂場所盜取香港市民的信用卡，隨即帶回香港購買高價值手提電話轉售圖利。
案件最少涉60宗，騙款總額超過180萬港元，個別受害人損失超過11萬元。香港警方拘16人，年齢17至45歲，涉嫌處理贓物、串謀詐騙及以欺騙手段取得財產。深圳方面拘17人，包括集團主腦。
調查顯示集團分三層運作：主腦負責招募卡手及聯絡扒手；監工負責運送信用卡並監察購物；卡手則在指定二手電話店購買手機套現後將贓款帶回深圳。
行動中檢獲13部用被盜信用卡購買的電話、9張被盜信用卡及多張單據。警方強調與深圳當局保持緊密情報交流，方能成功拘控。
